prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / animation production sheet.
Input reference: the approved nine-pose frog wizard sheet. Preserve THIS EXACT CHARACTER and graphic drawing style. We need additional drawings to animate from the reference's COMPOSED portrait to its DELIGHT portrait. This is a single 3 columns x 2 rows production pose sheet, SIX isolated head-and-shoulders portraits, all drawn at the same scale and front camera angle. Transparent background. No labels, text, borders, ground shadows or motion marks. Generous gutters and margins.
Style: chunky hand-inked flat-color game illustration, bold near-black organic contours, warm amber eyes, imperfect soft turquoise cheeks, deep plum scarf and floppy crooked hat with cream spiral decoration, charcoal shoulders, gold diamond clasp. Very few purposeful flat cel shadow patches. Match the drawing quality and asymmetry of the reference; no gradients, painting, glossy shading, hairline vector outlines or realistic texture. No human teeth.
TOP LEFT: anticipation drawing. Frog's head sinks low into the scarf, hat compressed slightly downward, eyes squeezed closed for a short anticipatory blink, mouth a small knowing closed smile, webbed hands still clasped below his chin.
TOP MIDDLE: rising transition drawing. Head lifting, eyes beginning to smile, mouth just starting to open into a wide smile. Both hands separating from their clasp and rising midway towards his cheeks, curved wrists, natural webbed finger shapes.
TOP RIGHT: delighted overshoot. Closely match the DELIGHT portrait in the reference: wide cheek-to-cheek grin, two upward-arched happy closed eyes, big pink tongue inside black toothless mouth, both hands splayed with the index fingertips pressing the outer cheeks upward. Head slightly squashed WIDE. Avoid turning the happy eyes into golden strips: give them the same round gold eye shapes and curved black closed-eye marks as reference.
BOTTOM LEFT: same delighted pose as top right, same head/hands/hat position, but speaking a closed M/B/P mouth. Warm broad CLOSED smile, cheeks still lifted, fingers still pressing cheeks, happy eyes unchanged.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: same delighted pose, same hands/eyes/hat, but speaking a rounded OH mouth. Small rounded black opening and protruding soft teal lips in the lower middle of the face, smile retained in cheeks.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same delighted pose, same hands/eyes/hat, but speaking a wide EE mouth. Flatter broad toothless mouth, small visible pink tongue. Happy and mischievous, NOT an angry grimace.
All six portraits end at the same chest baseline. Entire hat and all fingers visible with ample space. Maintain the original reference's large head, tiny shoulders and broad webbed hands. These are strong deliberately drawn animation key poses, not a generic rigged vector face.
